attr.cap: `#[cap: Name]` — the capabilities the function holds (checked by the compiler).
attr.cross_level: `#[cross_level: from -> to]` — a contract between two levels.
attr.effects: `#[effects: io, ...]` — the side effects the function may have (checked against its body).
attr.energy: `#[energy: low]` above a function: the VM idles while it runs; before every definition: the program's energy mode (low, balanced, performance).
attr.ensures: `#[ensures: condition]` — what the function guarantees about `result`; `til prove` proves it for all inputs.
attr.lang: `#[lang: ru]` / `#[lang: kk-latn]` — turn on Russian or Latin-Kazakh keywords for this file.
attr.level: `#[level: 0..4]` — the programming level: hardware, systems, safe (default), script, formal.
attr.pure: `#[pure]` — no side effects; the compiler checks the body.
attr.requires: `#[requires: condition]` — what callers must guarantee; checked at compile time with constants, else at run time.

bp.conditionMsg: Stop only when this expression is true (empty: always).

builtin.abs: The absolute value of a number.
builtin.args: The program's command-line arguments (`til run prog.til a b` → `["a", "b"]`).
builtin.bytes_to_str: Decodes a list of bytes (UTF-8) to a string.
builtin.ceil: Rounds up to the nearest integer.
builtin.chr: The character with this Unicode code point.
builtin.draw_circle: Draws a circle outline of radius `r` around (`cx`, `cy`).
builtin.draw_pixel: Sets one pixel to a colour (`0xRRGGBB`).
builtin.draw_text: Draws text in the built-in 5×7 font.
builtin.energy_mode: Gets or sets the battery-saving mode: `low`, `balanced`, `performance`.
builtin.exit: Ends the program with an exit code (default 0).
builtin.fill_rect: Fills a rectangle with a colour.
builtin.floor: Rounds down to the nearest integer.
builtin.format: Formats a value with a format spec, like `f"{x:.2f}"`.
builtin.get_pixel: The colour of a pixel of the screen (`0xRRGGBB`).
builtin.input: Reads one line from the user (prints the prompt first).
builtin.key_pressed: The next key pressed, or 0 when none (does not wait).
builtin.len: The length of a string, list or map.
builtin.max: The largest of the values (or of a list).
builtin.min: The smallest of the values (or of a list).
builtin.ord: The Unicode code point of a character.
builtin.panic: Stops with a runtime error (can be caught by `retry`).
builtin.print: Prints the values separated by spaces, then a new line.
builtin.println: Like `print`: the values and a new line.
builtin.random: A random number: `random()` in [0, 1), `random(n)` in [0, n), `random(a, b)` in [a, b].
builtin.screen_clear: Fills the whole screen with a colour (default black).
builtin.screen_height: The height of the screen in pixels.
builtin.screen_width: The width of the screen in pixels.
builtin.str: Converts a value to a string.
builtin.str_bytes: The UTF-8 bytes of a string.
builtin.sum: The sum of the values (or of a list).
builtin.type_of: The name of a value's type.
builtin.wait_key: Waits for a key and returns its code (arrows 1–4, Enter 13, Esc 27).

method.all: Whether `f(x)` is true for every element.
method.any: Whether `f(x)` is true for some element.
method.contains: Whether the string, list or map contains `x`.
method.delete: Removes a key from a map.
method.expect: The value of `Some`/`Ok`, or a runtime error with `message`.
method.filter: The elements for which `f(x)` is true.
method.get: The element at `index` (or the value of a key).
method.get_or: The value of `key`, or `default` when it is missing.
method.has: Whether a map has the key.
method.join: Joins the elements with `sep` into a string.
method.len: The number of elements or characters.
method.map: A new list with `f(x)` for every element.
method.pop: Removes and returns the last element.
method.reduce: Folds the list: `acc = f(acc, x)`, starting at `init`.
method.set: Sets the element at `index` (or the value of a key).
method.trim: The string without leading and trailing whitespace.
method.unwrap: The value of `Some`/`Ok`, or a runtime error.
